title: Trace one ticket through the stack
brief: Create ticket Printer offline from the browser and inspect its SQL row.
explanation: A complete feature includes validation, durable mutation, response decoding, and rendered confirmation.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Create ticket Printer offline from the browser and inspect its SQL row. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Trace the request through handler, Effect operation, repository, and response adapter.
Create once and reload the detail route directly. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: The same ticket identity and description survive reload.
No layer substitutes demo data for the accepted server record.
Recovery evidence: Reject the SQL insert and repeat the browser flow. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Reject the SQL insert and repeat the browser flow.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Can the reviewer identify the execution boundary and each dependency?
stretch: Add request correlation from browser action to safe server diagnostics.

title: Validate server-side title limits
brief: Submit a blank ticket title directly to the HTTP endpoint.
explanation: Client validation improves interaction but cannot enforce the server's domain contract.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Submit a blank ticket title directly to the HTTP endpoint. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Decode unknown request bodies before invoking the ticket repository.
Test blank, trimmed-valid, maximum-length, and overlong titles. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Valid titles persist in the normalized form.
Invalid input performs zero SQL writes.
Recovery evidence: Disable browser validation and repeat the same cases. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Disable browser validation and repeat the same cases.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does create and rename reuse one domain rule?
stretch: Add structured field errors that the browser maps to labeled controls.

title: Map missing tickets separately
brief: Open ticket T-404 after its record was removed from the database.
explanation: Missing resources and unavailable storage require different recovery experiences.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Open ticket T-404 after its record was removed from the database. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Return typed not-found and persistence failures from the service.
Request the missing ticket and inject a database connection failure. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Missing shows a usable return-to-list path.
A database outage is never presented as proof that the ticket was deleted.
Recovery evidence: Recover the database and reload the same route. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Recover the database and reload the same route.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the HTTP adapter preserve failure categories without leaking SQL details?
stretch: Add a retry control for temporary read failures.

title: Preserve ticket drafts after failure
brief: Write a detailed issue description and fail the first save with a server error.
explanation: Failed submission must retain the user's authored report and its attachments-in-progress state.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Write a detailed issue description and fail the first save with a server error. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Keep draft ownership separate from request status.
Fail, retry, and reload after a successful creation. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: The final ticket contains the original description exactly.
The failed attempt never clears text or claims successful creation.
Recovery evidence: Change one field while the first request is pending. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Change one field while the first request is pending.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Which draft snapshot does each response belong to?
stretch: Add explicit local draft persistence with a visible saved-at indicator.

title: Prevent duplicate ticket creation
brief: Double-click Submit and lose the first accepted response.
explanation: One creation intent needs stable identity across transport retries.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Double-click Submit and lose the first accepted response. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.

Deliver the same request concurrently and again after timeout. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Exactly one ticket and one creation event exist.
Repeated delivery cannot generate multiple ticket numbers.
Recovery evidence: Reuse the command ID with a different description. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Reuse the command ID with a different description.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the receiver detect inconsistent identity reuse?
stretch: Return the existing ticket link for a valid repeated creation request.

title: Keep SQL parameters separate

explanation: User text belongs in query parameters rather than executable query structure.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Search tickets for a string containing quotes and SQL-looking punctuation. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Use parameterized filters and explicitly allowlisted sort fields.
Search the hostile-looking text against a seeded fixture. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Only literal matching rows are returned.

Recovery evidence: Put the same input into a sort-field parameter. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Put the same input into a sort-field parameter.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the query builder separate values from selectable identifiers?
stretch: Add a contract test for every dynamic sort option.

title: Paginate with a stable order
brief: Create thirty tickets with several equal createdAt timestamps.
explanation: A ticket list needs deterministic ordering and defined continuation behavior.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Create thirty tickets with several equal createdAt timestamps. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Use a unique tiebreaker and encode the complete order in cursors.
Fetch all pages and compare collected IDs with the fixture. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Every expected ticket appears once.
Tied timestamps never cause page overlap or omissions.
Recovery evidence: Insert a new ticket between page requests. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Insert a new ticket between page requests.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the contract describe whether new records enter an ongoing traversal?
stretch: Add cursor validation and a recoverable expired-cursor state.

title: Preserve immutable ticket fields

explanation: An edit operation owns only explicitly editable fields.

Decode a narrow patch and reject or ignore reserved fields by policy.
Attempt title update with immutable-field additions. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: The title changes while creator, identity, and creation time remain intact.
Client payload cannot reattribute the ticket.
Recovery evidence: Send a whole old ticket object from a legacy client. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Send a whole old ticket object from a legacy client.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Did the agent spread request data directly into the SQL update?

title: Make create errors accessible
brief: Submit a ticket with two invalid fields using only the keyboard.
explanation: Field errors need semantic associations and predictable focus for recovery.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Submit a ticket with two invalid fields using only the keyboard. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Map server field paths to controls and a linked error summary.
Correct one field and resubmit without using a mouse. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Focus reaches the remaining invalid field.
Stale error descriptions disappear from corrected controls.
Recovery evidence: Return a form-wide storage error after all fields become valid. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Return a form-wide storage error after all fields become valid.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the status region announce useful change without repeating every render?
stretch: Test the form at narrow width with long translated error messages.

title: Define allowed status transitions
brief: Move a ticket from open to resolved, then attempt an unsupported resolved-to-triage transition.
explanation: Status changes need a domain transition table rather than arbitrary string assignment.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Move a ticket from open to resolved, then attempt an unsupported resolved-to-triage transition. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Encode allowed transitions and their required permissions.
Exercise every allowed and forbidden edge from the fixture states. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Allowed transitions record the intended resulting status.
Forbidden transitions leave status and history unchanged.
Recovery evidence: Send an unknown status through the API. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Send an unknown status through the API.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the backend enforce the table independently of dropdown options?
stretch: Add transition-specific required fields such as resolution notes.

title: Assign only eligible agents
brief: Assign a ticket to a user who belongs to another support team.
explanation: An assignee reference must satisfy current team membership and role eligibility.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Assign a ticket to a user who belongs to another support team. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Validate assignee eligibility inside the assignment operation.
Try active agent, inactive agent, outsider, and unassigned choices. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Only permitted assignees are stored.
A stale picker cannot assign an agent removed before submission.
Recovery evidence: Deactivate the agent between preview and mutation. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Deactivate the agent between preview and mutation.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the command distinguish invalid identity from temporarily unavailable lookup?
stretch: Add an explicit fallback policy when assigned agents leave the team.

title: Audit status with the mutation
brief: Resolve a ticket and fail insertion of its required history event.
explanation: A committed workflow change must have the audit evidence promised by the product.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Resolve a ticket and fail insertion of its required history event. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Persist status and transition event in one SQL transaction.
Inject failure after status update and before event insertion. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Both changes roll back together.
The ticket cannot appear resolved without its required transition record.
Recovery evidence: Retry the original command with the same identity. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Retry the original command with the same identity.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does idempotency cover history as well as current status?
stretch: Deliver external notifications through a transactional outbox.

title: Reject stale assignments
brief: Two team leads assign the same unassigned ticket to different agents.
explanation: A stale assignment must not silently replace an accepted newer decision.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Two team leads assign the same unassigned ticket to different agents. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Require expected ticket revision in the assignment command.
Submit both assignments against one revision. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: One assignment wins and advances revision once.
The loser receives current authorized assignment context.
Recovery evidence: Remove the winning agent before the loser reloads. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Remove the winning agent before the loser reloads.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does conflict recovery revalidate assignee eligibility?
stretch: Add an explicit reassign action that records the reason for overriding a current owner.

title: Separate public replies from notes
brief: An agent writes a private investigation note on a customer-visible ticket.
explanation: Internal notes and customer replies have different audiences and delivery effects.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: An agent writes a private investigation note on a customer-visible ticket. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Represent visibility explicitly and authorize both reads and writes.
View the ticket as customer, agent, and outsider. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Agents see permitted internal notes and customers see only public replies.
Private notes never enter customer exports or notifications.
Recovery evidence: Change a reply draft from public to private before sending. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Change a reply draft from public to private before sending.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does every downstream projection honor the same visibility field?
stretch: Require a deliberate conversion flow before publishing a previously private note.

title: Make reassignment notifications idempotent
brief: Assign a ticket successfully but time out while delivering its notification.
explanation: Notification delivery must not duplicate the assignment or produce repeated identical messages.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Assign a ticket successfully but time out while delivering its notification. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Record a notification intent keyed by the assignment event.
Replay delivery after an ambiguous provider response. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: One logical assignment event remains authoritative.
Retries do not create additional assignment history entries.
Recovery evidence: Reassign the ticket again before the first notification finishes. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Reassign the ticket again before the first notification finishes.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the notification indicate the event it represents rather than current state blindly?
stretch: Suppress or annotate obsolete notifications according to a documented policy.

title: Preserve conversation ordering
brief: Two agents post replies with the same timestamp during a handoff.
explanation: Conversation ordering needs a stable total order without inventing causal claims.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Two agents post replies with the same timestamp during a handoff. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Order by server timestamp and unique event sequence.
Load pages around the tied replies and compare IDs. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Both replies remain visible exactly once.
Client clock skew never places a new reply before unrelated historical messages.
Recovery evidence: Send a reply from a device whose clock is a day behind. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Send a reply from a device whose clock is a day behind.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the server own authoritative event timing?
stretch: Display edited markers without rewriting original conversation chronology.

title: Require resolution evidence
brief: Resolve a ticket marked needs-reproduction without a resolution note.
explanation: Certain transitions can require evidence beyond a target status value.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Resolve a ticket marked needs-reproduction without a resolution note. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Validate required resolution fields within the transition operation.
Attempt resolve with blank note, valid note, and unauthorized actor. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: A valid authorized resolution records its explanation.
Missing evidence leaves the ticket unresolved.
Recovery evidence: Delete the draft note before a delayed submit completes. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Delete the draft note before a delayed submit completes.

stretch: Add resolution categories with versioned reporting semantics.

title: Undo a mistaken assignment safely
brief: Undo an assignment after another lead has already reassigned the ticket.
explanation: Undo may reverse its own unchanged result but must not overwrite later decisions.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Undo an assignment after another lead has already reassigned the ticket. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Store the assignment event's resulting revision in the undo receipt.
Undo before and after a subsequent reassignment. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Untouched assignments can be reversed deliberately.
A stale undo preserves the later assignee and reports conflict.
Recovery evidence: Press Undo twice after the first reversal succeeds. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Press Undo twice after the first reversal succeeds.
review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does compensation append history rather than deleting the original event?

title: Compose search filters consistently

explanation: Combined filters should represent one coherent predicate across count and list queries.

Share validated filter interpretation between results and totals.
Seed tickets that each violate exactly one filter dimension. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.
checks: Only tickets satisfying every selected condition appear.
The total count cannot include rows excluded by the rendered list.
Recovery evidence: Clear text search while retaining status and assignee. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.
experiment: Clear text search while retaining status and assignee.

Private profile fields never enter the optimized list response.

checks: Allowed previews remain usable without application-origin execution.
